title: Clear Skies
description: A simple performance + essential mods modpack
body:
![Looking at jungle at day over water with shader pack enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ZHby8aRm/images/c0cf5b3079535ac6af40b64cc219891e86d90523_350.webp)

Clear Skies is a simple modpack designed to enhance your vanilla experience.

This modpack includes optimization mods, quality of life mods, and some others. There are some things in the pack (for example fresh animations and miniture shader) that you may want to disable, as they come down to personal preference. If you do, disable them in your launcher settings.

- [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/EsAfCjCV)
- [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/Wb5oqrBJ)
